input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Polish: align section index pages (Stories, Updates, queue, Research) with the site bar's 1,120 px column
errors: First build was started with a trailing '&' inside run_in_background; it kept running detached, so the second build refused (build lock) and I had to wait on dist.building instead of the log.
Ran 'git stash' to prove the new test fails on old code while a site build was reading the tree; checked afterwards that dist carried the new values, but it was a race.
New post's description was 190 characters; the build's 160 limit failed 175 site tests through one shared buildSite fixture. Fixed and reran.
Post seo_title was 73 characters (limit 70); caught by promptctl validate, after a second 8-minute suite run had already started with it.

doc_friction.issue: The post front-matter limits (description 60-160, seo_title <= 70) are checked by `promptctl.py validate`, but no doc I read on the polish path says to run it before the site suite; a too-long description instead shows up as 175 failing site tests (every test that builds the site).
A full site build (~8 min here) is the only way to see a one-line CSS change in stories/updates/queue; no partial rebuild for a single site-owned page is documented.

deviations.why: Its item 2 named Stories and Research; measured, Updates, the queue and the blog index were off too. I fixed four and left /writing/ (720 px reading column shared with every post) on purpose.
deviations.did: Aligned four pages, documented why writing stays centred
deviations.result: h1 matches the brand at 390/1,280/1,440 on all four

goal: impressive sites: consistent layout across section pages
notes: Measured with Playwright on the built dist: h1 left edge vs .pfs-bar content edge at 1,280 / 1,440 / 390. Before 96/176/176/176/74 (hub/stories/updates/queue/research) at 1,280; after all 96. scrollWidth = viewport everywhere. node platform/pages/check.mjs: publishable, 10,376 pages, no dead links. Site test suite (node --test 'platform/pages/*.test.mjs'): 1,695 pass, 0 fail after fixing the post's description (190 chars) and seo_title (73 chars), which had failed 175 and 167 tests in the first two runs. promptctl validate ok. CI on the PR: see merge.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: measure five section pages at three widths, change four column rules, check line length and tile orphans, write a guard test, screenshots, post and report

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
